comment: Machine form of the enforcement-table concept (docs/archive/SEMANTIC_WORKFLOW_PROGRAMS.md §3) — every workflow transition and what enforces it. hook = machine, cannot be ignored; exit-code = runtime-checked; prompt = model goodwill (the known failure surface; migrate rows upward one at a time). gate_runner pre-wave verifies hook rows are registered and present, exit-code rows exist, and reports the prompt-row count as the open migration surface. Keep rows aligned with settings.json and the hooks directory; a row here with no live file goes red at wave start.

transitions.transition: worktrees from slot ring only; no agent edits on main
raw `git worktree add` denied; landing protocol; pre-land verdict coverage (I1); persistent-cd denial; shell allowlist
debug escalation ladder — probe loops delegated, seam review first
memory is rules, not history
no bare #[allow(dead_code)]
explicit model per Agent spawn
lanes never spawn agents
teammate slot naming from the slot map
Agent-tool worktree isolation denied (slot ring instead)
worker seats rotate at ~200K context
a lane's report is its final text turn, never a SendMessage
verdicts written only by gate_runner (I2 edit guard)
GATE: brief gate commands executed verbatim, verdict to trail; gaming scan (D9)
pre-dispatch brief lint: anchors resolve, gates parse, slots valid, bead named, predecessors green (--requires phase ordering)
UI flow gate on touched paths at landing
docs index freshness on doc add/rename
clippy -D warnings before commit; workspace sweep + deny bans at landing
scoped tests per touched crate; gpu-proofs on GPU-path contact
one commit then stop for review (lanes)
lane retry cap 2 before park
brief completeness (findings, anchors, reuse target, conviction test, gates, scope)
lead reviews, does not author (D-55 context packs)

no new landing reports — landing prose in the merge commit
